name: Dead Bug

instructions.description: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent to about ninety degrees and arms reaching upward.
Gently press your lower back toward the mat and brace your abdominal wall.
Slowly lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor without letting your back arch.
Return to the start position and repeat on the other side with controlled breathing.

performanceMetrics.notes: Each arm-leg pair counts as one repetition per side.

variations.variationDescription: Both are floor-based trunk exercises, but dead bug emphasizes anti-extension control.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Keep arms still and tap heels down to simplify coordination.

commentsNotes: Only move through a range you can control without back arching.
Slow movement is more important than large movement.
